description: Uploads explicit local resource files and retries a preparation without overwriting original package files. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

preparation.description: Preparation job id returned by prepare_review.

file_path.description: Explicit local file path on the MCP client's machine.

path.description: Virtual package path referenced by the HTML.

resource_url.description: Original exact HTTPS URL when supplying an external resource.

name: supply_preparation_resources
